mapper.select:
select
from chat_msg where (from_user = #{username} and to_user = #{friend}) or (from_user = #{friend} and to_user = #{username}) order by create_date asc, id asc

select friend.username as friendUsername, friend.name as friendName, friend.userface as friendUserface, (select m2.content from chat_msg m2 where (m2.from_user = #{username} and m2.to_user = conv.username) or (m2.from_user = conv.username and m2.to_user = #{username}) order by m2.create_date desc, m2.id desc limit 1) as lastMessage, (select m3.create_date from chat_msg m3 where (m3.from_user = #{username} and m3.to_user = conv.username) or (m3.from_user = conv.username and m3.to_user = #{username}) order by m3.create_date desc, m3.id desc limit 1) as lastMessageTime, (select count(*) from chat_msg m4 where m4.from_user = conv.username and m4.to_user = #{username} and m4.status = 0) as unreadCount from ( select distinct case when from_user = #{username} then to_user else from_user end as username from chat_msg where from_user = #{username} or to_user = #{username} ) conv join hr friend on friend.username = conv.username order by lastMessageTime desc
